citations.quote: State is data that lives inside a component itself. It can change over time, and it's up to the component to manage those changes. Props, on the other hand, are used to pass data into a component from its parent.

summary.text: State is data that lives inside a component and can change over time; it's managed by the component. Props are data passed into a component from its parent, akin to read-only snapshots, and cannot be changed from within the component.
